title: Adrastus asks for ransom
intro: A catalogue of deaths gives way to a captured Trojan's plea. Watch dual forms for the horses.

notes.text: βαίνω, go: unaugmented 3sg root aor; μετά + acc, “went after.”
νηΐς, water-nymph; τίκτω, bear: unaugmented 3sg 2aor; ἀμύμων, excellent / blameless: dat sg.
ἀγαυός, illustrious; πρέσβυς superlative, eldest; γενεή dat of respect, by birth.
σκότιος, secret / born outside marriage: acc sg; γείνομαι, bear: unaugmented 3sg aor mid. ἑ = him.
ποιμαίνω, tend flocks: pres ptc; ὄϊς, sheep: dat pl, epic -εσσι.
μίγνυμι, mingle: unaugmented 3sg 2aor pass, “lay with her”; φιλότης, intimacy, and εὐνή, bed: dat sg.
ὑποκύομαι, conceive: aor mid ptc nom fem sg.
διδυμάων, twin, and παῖς, child: acc dual; γείνατο, bore.
ὑπολύω, loosen / undo: 3sg aor; γυῖα, limbs. A killing formula: removes strength and control of the body.
Son of Mecisteus, Euryalus; συλάω, strip: 3sg impf. τεύχεα, armour, removed from shoulders.
πέφνω, slay: reduplicated 2aor; μενεπτόλεμος, steadfast in battle.
Supply the preceding verb “slew”; catalogue syntax repeatedly omits it.
ἐναίρω, slay: 3sg aor mid; δόρυ dat sg; φαεινός, shining.
ἐϋρρείτης, fair-flowing: gen sg -αο, river epithet; ὄχθη, bank: acc pl.
αἰπεινός, steep; acc of place inhabited after ναῖε (34).
αἱρέω, take / kill: unaugmented 3sg 2aor; φεύγω pres ptc acc sg, “as he fled.”
“Captured alive”; ζωός, alive, predicate acc; αἱρέω 3sg 2aor.
ἵππος + ἀτύζομαι, be terrified: nom dual. πεδίοιο: gen of space traversed, across the plain.
ὄζος, branch; μυρίκινος, of tamarisk. βλάπτω, hinder / entangle: aor pass ptc nom dual.
ἀγκύλος, curved; ἅρμα, chariot; ἄγνυμι, break: aor act ptc nom dual. Distinguish ἄγω.
ῥυμός, chariot-pole; “at the pole's front end.” βαίνω: 3dual root aor.
ᾗ, where / by which way; περ emphasizes. φοβέομαι, flee in panic: unaugmented 3pl impf.
ἐκκυλίω, roll out: 3sg aor pass; πρηνής, face down / headlong; τροχός, wheel; κονίη, dust.
Long-shadowed; spear epithet, δολιχός + σκιά.
λαμβάνω 2aor ptc + gen of part grasped; γόνυ, knee: gen pl. Grasping knees marks supplication.
λίσσομαι, entreat: 3sg impf mid.
ζωγρέω, take alive / spare: 2sg pres imperative. δέχομαι 2sg aor mid imperative; ἄποινα, ransom (neut pl).
κειμήλια, stored valuables; κεῖμαι, lie: 3sg pres, neut pl subject + sg verb.
πολύκμητος, much-worked / wrought with toil; σίδηρος, iron, valuable alongside bronze and gold.
χαρίζομαι, give gladly: 3sg aor mid opt + κεν, potential. ἀπερείσιος, boundless / countless.
πυνθάνομαι, learn: 3sg reduplicated aor mid opt; “if he should learn that I am alive.” νηυσίν dat pl of ναῦς.
